subject: CAIQ evidence triage and legal handoff - Solaris Health
messages:
From: Ellen Zhao <ellen.zhao@solarislabs.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>, Tom Briggs <t.briggs@solarislabs.com>
Cc: Solaris Health Security <security@solarislabs.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ: initial evidence intake for Solaris Health

Hi Priya —

Thanks for taking this on. We've completed our initial scan of scope and attached the CAIQ that Solaris asked us to complete. High level context: Solaris is looking for a fast turnaround on 35 critical controls (primarily data residency, key management, and runtime isolation) with evidence for a pilot scope covering production and staging accounts.

Can you confirm:
- Which controls you want us to prioritize for the first delivery window (48–72 hours)?
- Format preferences for evidence (OKTA screenshots vs. CSV exports vs. redacted log snippets)?
- Any required legal/contract gating before we upload sensitive artifacts?

I've included Tom (security lead) and security@solarislabs for visibility. The attached worksheet is our initial CAIQ export.

Thanks,
Ellen
Ellen Zhao
Director of Security Operations
Solaris Health

Attachments: solaris_caiq_export.xlsx (spreadsheet, 460KB)

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Ellen Zhao <ellen.zhao@solarislabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 10:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ: initial evidence intake for Solaris Health

Hi Ellen —

Appreciate the worksheet and the scope note. Proposed triage and next steps below — looking for confirmation so we can lock owners and share the upload link.

1) Priority control group (48–72h):
   - Identity & Access Management (IAM): ID.5, ID.7
   - Data Residency & Encryption: DSR.1, DSR.3
   - Runtime Isolation / Multi-tenancy: ISOL.2

2) Evidence format (preferred):
   - Configuration screenshots for policies (OKTA, GCP IAM) OR exported CSV with SID/role mappings
   - Redacted log snippets for runtime isolation (t=last 7 days) in .txt or .csv
   - Short owner attestation email for controls requiring human confirmation

3) Legal gating: we can accept uploads to the temporary secure collection once Solaris confirms the signed NDA/engagement order. If you prefer, we can provide a pre-authenticated S3 upload link after legal acknowledges the scope.

I've attached our working CAIQ answer sheet (caiq_answer_sheet_v2.xlsx) with preliminary answers and an "evidence_owner" column. Action items:
- Ellen/Tom: confirm priority group and whether OKTA screenshots are acceptable for IAM (reply-all) — by EOD today if possible.
- Solaris security: confirm NDA/engagement upload permission.
- Karthik, Marissa: once confirmed, populate owners and prepare evidence templates (see column G in attached).

I'll block a 30m sync tomorrow morning if we need to walk through ownership.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: caiq_answer_sheet_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet, 120KB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 15:30:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: CAIQ: initial evidence intake for Solaris Health

Priya —

Internal follow-up / clarifications before we hand any upload links over:

- For IAM controls: we need either (A) screenshots showing the OKTA application-level assignment and policy timelines *and* CSV export of active service accounts OR (B) a signed attestation from Solaris' IAM owner plus CSV. Screenshots alone will not satisfy audit samples.
- For runtime isolation (ISOL.2): provide a 7-day sample of tenant-specific telemetry (redacted) and a short narrative describing GPU/VM tenancy enforcement. Redaction guidance is in our evidence template; please confirm Solaris can apply it.
- For encryption concerns (DSR.3): we need key policy excerpts and key rotation history (last 90 days) — CSV is fine.

I've started an evidence-owner roster (attached) that maps each control to a primary and secondary owner at Redwood. Once Solaris confirms formats, I'll lock owners and generate the upload link with presigned S3 tokens.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Manager, Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: evidence-owners.csv (CSV, 5KB)

From: Ellen Zhao <ellen.zhao@solarislabs.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Briggs <t.briggs@solarislabs.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ evidence triage and legal handoff for Solaris Health

Thanks — this looks good. Confirming:

- Solaris will prioritize the IAM and Data Residency controls for the first delivery window. We can provide CSV exports for IAM and key rotation history for encryption.
- We will produce a redacted telemetry snippet for runtime isolation (format: .txt, max 2MB).
- Legal: signed engagement letter is on its way — expect an email from our legal team (legal@solarislabs.com) by EOD today.

Next steps from our side:
- We'll upload IAM CSV and key rotation CSV to the link you provide after legal confirms.
- We'll also attach a one-line attestation for any control that requires an owner signature.

If you can generate the upload link once legal confirms, we'll aim for delivery within 48 hours. Appreciate the clear triage and template.

Best regards,
Ellen
Director of Security Operations
Solaris Health

Inline note: Tom — looping you to ensure your team signs the engagement letter promptly.
